claim_scope: train-only closed-loop continuation of the live four-GPU pyramid-MoE pretraining run; no validation or test_id claim during training
hypothesis: Starting at epoch 22, bounded exponentiated reweighting of family-by-frequency-block losses from a fixed balanced train-only probe will reduce a minimax-oriented train-probe relative-error objective versus fixed weighting without causing non-finite optimization or collapsing any family/frequency weight below the registered coverage floor.
expected_mechanism: The full-information online controller raises gradient emphasis for persistently difficult medium-family and spectral-block cells while EMA, geometric normalization, per-epoch action clipping, and absolute multiplier bounds preserve coverage and global loss scale.
literature_basis: Graves et al., Automated Curriculum Learning for Neural Networks, ICML 2017
Chen et al., GradNorm: Gradient Normalization for Adaptive Loss Balancing, ICML 2018
Li et al., Physics-Informed Neural Operator, arXiv:2111.03794

data.frequency_schedule: unchanged sample-hash offset plus deterministic epoch rotation

controller.feedback_metric: mean normalized spectral energy error per family-frequency cell
controller.objective: 0.5 * mean cell relative error + 0.5 * worst cell relative error

handoff.handoff_policy: SIGSTOP the fixed trainer after atomic epoch-boundary checkpoint publication, hard-link and hash the checkpoint, then terminate the fixed process group

primary_metric: train-only controller objective trajectory, reported with all family-by-frequency cells
failure_signal: Stop on missed epoch boundary, binding drift, non-finite probe/loss/gradient, controller weight outside [0.5, 2.0], DDP rank failure, absent smoke artifacts, or any validation/test_id access.
promotion_rule: Training-probe improvement cannot promote the checkpoint. Freeze the controller and checkpoint first, then run one complete registered validation evaluation and one independent test_id confirmation only if validation passes.
rollback: Keep the epoch-21 boundary snapshot immutable. If the controller is unstable or loses on disjoint train evidence, stop the adaptive run and resume fixed-weight training from that snapshot in a separate versioned output directory. Preserve all A3, B2-H, Helmholtz, ASAM, CPADC, and prior accepted checkpoints.
